intended_object: The isomorphism of schemes over Spec K from U × D (unitriangular group scheme times diagonal torus) to B (upper-triangular group scheme), given on points by (v, d) ↦ e(d)·i(v). Here i is the inclusion U ↪ B and e is the diagonal section D → B. This is the standard "multiplication is an isomorphism T × U ≅ B" decomposition, as in Milne §§2.20–2.21. The source is the docstring and the module documentation.
